description: Tracked, iterable registry of disposable-save cohorts and the TBG-owned canonical disposable save. Individual on-disk save files and paths are machine-local; this registry tracks the durable name patterns, cohorts, and the version family under which automated mutation is authorized. A fresh disposable save can be created by scripts/tbg/Update-TbgDisposableSaveRegistry.ps1 -CreateOwned without opening a new sprint.

compatibility.note: Automated mutation is authorized only for saves in the disposable cohort AND created under a supported game-version family. Calendar year alone is never disposable authority.

ownedCanonical.role: canonical TBG-owned disposable save; DevSaveResolver prefix mirror
ownedCanonical.note: When a fresh owned save is needed, the updater creates BlacksmithGuild_Disposable_<timestamp>.sav and records it here; it is machine-local on disk but pattern-tracked here.

cohorts.purpose: Canonical dev-start disposable save for QuickStart/priority-engine automation.
Agent-generated disposable saves created by the updater for isolated automation runs.
Operator personal, scratch, and named-milestone saves. Never eligible for automated mutation regardless of calendar year.

proofBoundary: Registry membership authorizes automation mutation of disposable-cohort saves only, and only under the supported game-version family. It is not launcher, campaign-ready, movement, or trade proof.
